meta_description: Adrian Bainbridge Plastering in Leeds offers expert interior and exterior plastering. Fast, reliable workmanship. Call for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: From cracked walls to full house replastering, we deliver smooth finishes on time and on budget across Leeds.
services_subhead: Whether you need repair work, skimming, or a full replaster, we handle domestic and commercial projects with precision.

services.title: Internal Wall Plastering
services.desc: Full replastering of interior walls and ceilings. We deliver smooth, paint-ready finishes that last for decades.

services.title: Plasterboard & Drywall Finishing
services.desc: Professional taping, jointing, and skimming of new plasterboard to a showroom standard.

services.title: Crack Repair & Patch Plastering
services.desc: Quick fixes for cracks, holes, and damaged sections. We match existing finishes so repairs blend seamlessly.

services.title: Artex Removal & Ceiling Skimming
services.desc: Strip old Artex and replace with modern, smooth skimmed ceilings. Safe, clean removal and professional finish.

services.title: External Render & Harling
services.desc: Weather-resistant external plastering and render work to protect and improve your home's façade.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Plastering
services.desc: Large-scale projects for offices, retail units, and warehouses. We work around your business schedule.

about_pullquote: I turn rough walls into rooms you're proud to live in.
about_para_1: Adrian Bainbridge has been plastering homes and businesses across Leeds for over two decades. Starting as an apprentice, he built his reputation on meticulous attention to detail and honest, straightforward pricing. Today, he manages every job personally — whether it's a small patch or a full house replaster.
about_para_2: Repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals are the backbone of the business. Adrian takes pride in leaving every site clean and tidy, respecting your home as much as his own. He sources quality materials, arrives when he says he will, and guarantees his work stands up to scrutiny.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Adrian

reviews.text: Had Adrian in to replaster our lounge after some water damage. He was professional, worked quickly, and the finish is brilliant. Fair price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Adrian came to patch and skim our ceiling. He turned up on time, did the job properly, and the room looks perfect. Been recommended to three of our neighbours already.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Needed the whole kitchen replastered before we could decorate. Adrian organised everything and finished bang on schedule. Very tidy worker, great communication. Will use again.
reviews.author: David S.
